messages:
maya: Tiny unscientific poll — which throwback holiday soundtrack should I queue for tonight's cozy coding session? 🎄☕
devin: Home Alone OST. full stop. John Williams nostalgia crash.
samir: Elf soundtrack is ridiculous and cheerful, perfect for bugs. :elf:
alicia: Muppet Christmas Carol for the vibes. soft, weirdly comforting.
ben: die hard soundtrack? (joking) also love some classic crooners. :grin:
maya: OK vote with emoji: 🟢 = Home Alone, 🔵 = Elf, 🟣 = Muppet, 🔴 = Die Hard/Action Xmas. I'll tally in ~10m.
playlist-bot: quick playlist I threw together: https://open.spotify.com/playlist/fake-throwback-holiday (curated 2hr mix)
devin: +1 on the playlist link. can you add "Somewhere in My Memory" please?
playlist-bot: added "Somewhere in My Memory" — now at 92 tracks.
samir: 🔵 for Elf from me. gonna drop a gif in case anyone needs convincing.
(alicia drops a tiny GIF of Kermit singing)
ben: 🟣 — Muppet recounting childhood feels. also: holiday jazz interlude recs?
maya: ok quick summary: 🟢 Home Alone x2, 🔵 Elf x3, 🟣 Muppet x2, 🔴 Die Hard x1. going with Elf+Muppet blend. thanks all, playlist set for tonight's pair-programming cocoon. :headphones:
